seoTitle: Apply Sales Tax on Squarespace With Automated Options
metaDescription: Set up sales tax rates in Squarespace by country so your online store stays compliant, using the built-in Taxes settings.
intro: Getting sales tax right is an essential step for any Squarespace store, and the platform's Taxes settings make it straightforward to add rates by country. This guide walks through finding the Taxes section and creating a new tax rate for your business.

steps.heading: Log in to Squarespace
steps.body: Sign in to your account, using Continue with Google if that's how it's linked, then access your website dashboard.

steps.heading: Open Selling settings
steps.body: Navigate to Settings, then Selling, where Squarespace groups all tools related to your selling process.

steps.heading: Go to the Taxes section
steps.body: Click Taxes to manage how tax works on your site, then click Add Rate to begin adding a specific rate.

steps.heading: Select your country and name the tax
steps.body: Choose the country the rate applies to, click Next, and give the tax a clear, specific name so you can identify it later in orders.

steps.heading: Enter the rate and save
steps.body: Input the tax percentage for your selected country, confirming it against current local tax laws, then click Save to apply it.

faq.question: Can I set different tax rates for different countries?
faq.answer: Yes, you select a country when creating each tax rate, so you can configure multiple rates for different regions.

faq.question: How do I know what tax rate to enter?
faq.answer: Research and confirm the current rate that applies to your business and location to stay compliant with local tax laws.

faq.question: Where do I find my saved tax rates later?
faq.answer: They live in the Taxes section under Settings, then Selling, where you can review or edit them anytime.

faq.question: Does naming the tax rate matter?
faq.answer: Yes, a specific name helps you identify the rate later when reviewing orders or adjusting your site's tax settings.
